provenance.measurements_source: Public-derived subset (first 180 rows, 4 geometric features) from scikit-learn load_breast_cancer (UCI WDBC); clinical diagnosis labels intentionally omitted.
provenance.synthetic_alterations: Synthetic sample_id, lab_site, instrument, site_metadata_SYNTHETIC.json, and injected missing/non-positive values for educational data wrangling only.
provenance.clinical_disclaimer: Educational preprocessing artifact only; must not be used for medical diagnosis or clinical decisions.

cleaning_decisions.invalid_mean_area: Rows with mean_area <= 0 (SMP-0008, mean_area=-15.0) are excluded from train/test matrices and recorded in general_quality_report.csv.
cleaning_decisions.missing_values: Valid rows with missing numeric measurements are retained and imputed using training-set medians only.
cleaning_decisions.outliers: 1.5*IQR outlier candidates are flagged in general_quality_report.csv and retained rather than blindly deleted.
cleaning_decisions.unmatched_site_rule: Left join on lab_site; unmatched keys map to region='UNMAPPED_SITE' with unmatched_site_flag=1.

engineered_features.area_per_radius_sq: mean_area / (mean_radius ** 2) after training-only median imputation, guarded for mean_radius > 0.
engineered_features.texture_perimeter_ratio: mean_texture / mean_perimeter after training-only median imputation, guarded for mean_perimeter > 0.
